on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			TST = {
				recruit_character = lp_tst_alpha_leader
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_character = TST_bravo_old }
						NOT = { has_character = TST_bravo_renamed }
					}
					recruit_character = lp_tst_bravo_leader
				}
				recruit_character = lp_tst_charlie_leader
				if = {
					limit = { has_character = TST_delta_advisor }
					TST_delta_advisor = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_army_leader = yes } }
							add_corps_commander_role = {
								skill = 3
								attack_skill = 2
								defense_skill = 3
								planning_skill = 3
								logistics_skill = 2
							}
							set_portraits = {
								army = { large = GFX_portrait_lp_tst_delta_advisor }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_character = TST_echo_navy_chief }
					TST_echo_navy_chief = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } }
							add_naval_commander_role = {
								traits = { seawolf }
								skill = 3
								attack_skill = 2
								defense_skill = 2
								maneuvering_skill = 3
								coordination_skill = 3
							}
							set_portraits = {
								army = { large = GFX_portrait_lp_tst_echo_admiral }
								navy = { large = GFX_portrait_lp_tst_echo_admiral }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
